label: lem:interval_integrable_restriction
title: Restriction to sub-intervals
statement: If $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,b]$ and $x$ lies in the interior, then $f$ is interval integrable on $[a,x]$. This is \texttt{IntervalIntegrable.mono\_set}, using the inclusion $\texttt{uIcc}\; a\; x \subseteq \texttt{uIcc}\; a\; b$.
proof: Monotonicity of integrability with respect to the domain.
